title: feat(pm): a seat timestamp comes from the clock that writes it — `{{NOW}}` on the write side, H56 on the read side
body:
Fixes #17314

A seat's timestamp had two possible origins and only one of them was legal. This makes the illegal one unspellable on the write side and visible on the read side, and both halves read ONE definition of what a stamp is.

Filed as mechanism, not discipline, because the discipline remedy is spent: the triage seat post carries the same failure twice — R+164 (「轮次计时全靠感觉,错了约 4 倍」) and R+165, ~70 minutes off with roughly fifteen audit comments stamped from memory — with a "measure it next time" note written between them that did not hold.

## Both halves, and why both

The card offers either half. Both landed, because neither alone removes the spelling:

- the **write side** removes it on the channel it owns — a seat that calls the tool cannot type a time;
- the **read side** is what sees the artefacts that did not come through the tool. The recorded failure's ~15 comments carried no token at all, so a write-side-only mechanism would not have caught it.

### Write side — `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs`

Posts a comment (`POST /repos/{o}/{r}/issues/{n}/comments`) or rewrites a card body (`PATCH …/issues/{n}`) over REST with `GH_TOKEN`, body from `--file=PATH` or stdin. Two spellings, no third:

- `{{NOW}}` — the clock read in THIS invocation. Two tokens in one body get one stamp: one clock, read once.
- `{{WAS:YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ}}` — a stamp that is a reading of something else, declared and rendered verbatim. Its contents must be exactly one stamp, so it is a declaration and not a free-text escape.

Then it reads the artefact back and prints the proof: id, url, the platform's own write time (`created_at` for a comment, `updated_at` for a body edit — that is when the write happened), the DRIFT between that instant and the substituted stamp, and a byte comparison of the stored body against the bytes sent, so a body the sanitizer mutated is reported rather than assumed.

`--dry-run` prints the substituted body and writes nothing. It ACTS by default where its sibling `sweep-closed-cards.mjs` dry-runs, and the header argues the asymmetry: that one is a machine choosing its own targets across the archive, this one writes one artefact to a target the caller named, and a helper with friction gets bypassed for the channel that has none.

### Read side — H56 in `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`

Report-only, band `state` — H44's band, because it is H44's class one field over: a reading that cannot be dated (H44), and a reading whose date is wrong (H56). It reads exactly the corpus H44 already fetched and **buys no request**, placed after H44's loop and BEFORE H46, whose leg (b) widens the cache — reading after H46 would give the two censuses different populations.

Two false-positive sources are closed rather than tolerated:

- a minute-grained stamp names a MINUTE, so `2026-09-10T06:37Z` with a `created_at` of `06:37:48` is zero drift, not one rounded minute. Without this every correctly stamped comment in the corpus would file a row.
- an EDITED comment keeps its original `created_at` while its text may legitimately have been rewritten, so the comparison is against the whole `created_at`..`updated_at` window. Where that window is wide the row goes quiet — a stated under-read, declared in the census clause.

A line carrying more than one stamp is HELD OUT and counted, never guessed at: which of two stamps is the act's own is a meaning question, and answering it by guessing would file a row against a correctly stamped artefact. So the rows are a LOWER BOUND and the census says by how much.

## The refusals, demonstrated

```
$ node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=17314 --file=demo-bare.md ; echo "EXIT=$?"
post-stamped: REFUSED — 1 stamp-contract problem(s) in the body. Nothing was written.
  1. [positional] the opening line carries the bare stamp `2026-09-10T05:27Z`. That position belongs
     to the writing act, so a stamp typed there is the act's own time written from memory — the defect
     this tool exists to make unspellable. Write `{{NOW}}` there, or `{{WAS:2026-09-10T05:27Z}}` if it
     is genuinely a reading of something else.
EXIT=2

$ node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=17314 --file=demo-mixed.md ; echo "EXIT=$?"
post-stamped: REFUSED — 1 stamp-contract problem(s) in the body. Nothing was written.
  1. [mixed] this body uses `{{NOW}}` and also carries the bare stamp `2026-09-08T14:00Z`. One of the
     two clocks was read by this act and the other was typed; a reader cannot tell which. …
EXIT=2

$ node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --dry-run --comment=17314 --file=demo-ok.md ; echo "EXIT=$?"
post-stamped: DRY RUN — nothing was written. 1 token(s) substituted with `2026-09-10T06:53Z`,
1 quoted stamp(s) rendered verbatim. Target would be objectstack-ai/objectstack#17314 (comment).
Claim: skills seat, session `session_x`, 2026-09-10T06:53Z — dispatched into the round.

The board read 2026-09-08T14:00Z still stands.
EXIT=0
```

⛔ The positional refusal is not the mixed one widened for tidiness. Mixed alone never fires on a seat that simply does not type `{{NOW}}` — which is every comment in the recorded failure.

## The pointer line — LANDED, net-zero

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md` is at 91/91 with zero headroom, so the pointer was folded in place rather than added, at L28:

```diff
-- 写侧刷新点的三个时刻:派发时、收班时、暂停或交接前。
+- 写侧刷新三时刻:派发、收班、暂停或交接前;时间戳恒取自 `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs`。
```

91 lines before and after (`check:pm-skill-ratchet` green), 112 bytes against the 120-byte per-line budget, all three refresh moments intact. The `{{NOW}}` token itself is NOT spelled in the skill file — it did not fit the byte budget without dropping one of the three moments, and the tool documents it in `--help` and refuses every other spelling, so naming the tool names the whole mechanism. `references/platform-readings.md` was not touched (PR #17317 holds it).

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** — 座位往 GitHub 写的每一个时间戳,现在都由写它的那一次调用去读钟。新工具 `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` 负责发评论/改正文:正文里写 `{{NOW}}` 占位,工具在同一次调用里取 UTC 时刻替换,写完再回读一次,把平台自己盖的时间、与替换时刻的差、以及存下来的字节是否被改动都打印出来。配套的 `check-half-states.mjs` 加了一条只报告不拦截的 H56 行,拿平台的 `created_at` 去核对评论里手写的时间戳,超过 15 分钟的列出来。座位贴协议在原有行数内改写一行,点名这个工具。

**为什么改** — 同一个错误在分诊座位贴上记录了两次(R+164 与 R+165,后者差了约 70 分钟、约 15 条审计评论带着估算时间),中间那次「下回记得测量」的纪律性补救没有守住。估算出来的时间戳此前有拼法可写,这个 PR 把这个拼法删掉。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** — 新工具没有任何自动调用方:workflow 只跑它的离线自检,不会往任何卡片写字。风险集中在 H56 落地当天可能在巡查锚点上一次性冒出若干行——它是 report-only、band 为 `state`,预算不够时本来就会被裁掉,不会挡任何门禁。误报的两个来源(分钟粒度、评论被编辑过)已在实现里各自关掉。回滚代价极低:H56 一行注册加一段循环,工具是独立新文件,都可以单独还原,不牵动任何已发布的包。

**席位意见** —

**你要做的** — 只需决定要不要把「时间戳走这个工具」推成全体座位的默认写法。合并本身按受管面规矩由维护者手动合;不需要发版,不涉及任何已发布的包。

## Acceptance notes

- **Gates: 74 derived, 71 run green, 3 NOT MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran <record>` exits 0 — 「74 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 71 run, 3 NOT-MEASURED (3 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)」. Every exit code was captured before any pipe and recorded as `<command> :: exit <code>`, which is what lets the tool derive the NOT-MEASURED count instead of taking the runner's word for it. The three are `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:type-check-debt`, each exiting 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET because it loads BUILT output; each ran its own self-test green first. They are derived from `package.json` being in the diff, not from any package changing — no package source is touched, so no build closure is owed. `check:doc-formula-expressions` also refused its prerequisite first; it was cleared by building `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (`VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 156s · waited 0s`) and then exited 0.
- **`pnpm lint` (repo-wide, `eslint . --no-inline-config`): exit 0** on the final commit `0e9f0fd93`. Run whole rather than narrowed, so no narrowing claim is being made.
- **The tool refuses a body that discusses its own tokens.** The `os-dev-report` comment on #17314 came back `exit 2 [quoted-not-a-stamp]` on its first attempt, because its prose spelled the quoted-stamp token literally. That is the contract holding — there is deliberately no escape hatch — and the remedy is the author's: name the token without its braces. Recorded because every reader who writes *about* the mechanism meets it once.
- **The read-back earned its keep on the first real post.** That same comment reports `sent 10337 byte(s), stored 10337 — the platform MUTATED the body`: GitHub inserted one blank line before the attribution rule and dropped the trailing newline, net zero bytes. A length comparison would have called that identical. The stamp leg read `drift 0 — one clock, one act`.
- **Changeset: none owed.** The diff is `.claude/**`, `.github/workflows/**`, the private root `package.json` (`"private": true`, `@objectstack/spec-monorepo`) and `scripts/pm/**` — the skip-changeset fast track by shape; nothing any package's `files[]` ships moves. `skip-changeset` applied by the author.
- **Terminal: GOVERNED.** `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test …` exits 3: 「1 of 5 path(s) hit the register … ⛔ GOVERNED — a human merge is the review record for this PR」, on `.claude/**` ×1. Quoted because the register is what decides it: the four `scripts/pm/**`, workflow and `package.json` paths are explicitly NOT on it — 「paths not on the register: .github/workflows/lint.yml, package.json, scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs, scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs」. So this stays a DRAFT: no seat flips it ready, enqueues it or arms auto-merge.
- **Self-test wiring.** `check:pm-post-stamped` is in `package.json` and run by a `lint.yml` step, so `check-self-test-wired` sees it as named AND self-tested rather than as a script whose only instrument nothing runs. Its live path writes to a card, so — like every `check:pm-*` step around it — CI runs the offline half only.
- **Out of scope, noted, not filed:** `sweep-closed-cards.mjs` composes the comments it posts with its own timestamps and does not route through this tool. Folding it in is a behaviour change to a scheduled writer and belongs on its own card, not on this one. 承接者:the skills seat, when the token route stops being new.
- **Out of scope, noted, not filed:** the `{{NOW}}` token is not named in any skill file — only the tool is (byte budget, above). If the seat wants the token spelled in the protocol, that is a line the skills seat lands with its own ratchet accounting.
